summary: Three of five dimensions FAIL. The builder addressed 12 of 15 previous findings adequately (FIND-001/002/003/004/006/008/009/010/011/013/014/015). Three previous findings remain partially or fully unaddressed: FIND-005 (REQ-SYNC-011 ambiguity), FIND-007 (REQ-SYNC-015 EARS — only 013 was fixed), and FIND-012 (evaluateSubscriptionSearchResult compressed property). Spec completeness fails due to duplicated REQ-SYNC-021, underspecified REQ-SYNC-024 30-minute threshold behavior, and the unresolved REQ-SYNC-011 ambiguity. EARS compliance passes — the vast majority of requirements use correct EARS patterns and the remaining REQ-SYNC-015 issue is a minor stylistic consistency problem. Purity boundary passes — the pure/effectful split is well-defined and the crypto.timingSafeEqual usage is acceptable for a deterministic function. Verification coverage fails due to missing property tests for safety-critical pure functions (canResolveInflightOperation, shouldSyncRole, isStatusUnknown, evaluateSubscriptionSearchResult), a missing 503 DB-unavailability integration test for REQ-SYNC-013, and orphaned tests (INT-SYNC-023, PROP-SYNC-010) not mapped in traceability. Traceability fails due to orphaned test mappings and the REQ-SYNC-021 duplication creating ambiguous requirement anchoring.

evidence.description: 30 REQ-SYNC requirements reviewed (lines 69-342). REQ-SYNC-021 duplicated at lines 267 and 333. REQ-SYNC-024 30-minute threshold behavior undefined. REQ-SYNC-011 role revocation on failed member resolution ambiguous.
Cross-referenced sections 5.3 (lines 148-164) and 5.4 (lines 166-181). All source design requirements reflected in behavioral spec.

T-P0-04 (lines 154-205), T-P0-06 (lines 270-299), T-P0-07 (lines 301-349) cross-referenced. Previous gaps (inflight thresholds, env vars, individual resync errors) now covered by REQ-SYNC-024/028/030.

30 requirements reviewed for EARS compliance. 28 use proper WHEN/THE SYSTEM SHALL or IF/THE SYSTEM SHALL patterns. REQ-SYNC-013 was fixed with proper trigger (line 189). REQ-SYNC-015 (line 204) and REQ-SYNC-025 (line 300) use Ubiquitous EARS pattern without trigger, which is technically valid per EARS taxonomy. FIND-104 is a minor stylistic consistency issue that does not introduce ambiguity.

Pure core (lines 11-39, 27 functions) and effectful shell (lines 41-63, 21 functions) reviewed. canResolveInflightOperation now has explicit 4-parameter signature (line 35). validateWebhookToken correctly uses crypto.timingSafeEqual as a deterministic function. validateWebhookRequiredEnvVars now has corresponding REQ-SYNC-028.

Purity boundary map (lines 10-70) reviewed. All 27 pure functions are properly classified. Effectful shell functions all involve DB/HTTP/log I/O. No purity violations detected. FIND-105 is about property documentation completeness, not a purity boundary violation.

15 PROP-SYNC tests cover 15 of 27 pure core functions. 38 INT-SYNC tests cover 30 REQ-SYNC requirements. 5 mutation testing targets defined. Previous gaps (INT-SYNC-031/032/033/034/035/036/037/038) addressed. Remaining gaps: no PROP-SYNC for canResolveInflightOperation/shouldSyncRole/isStatusUnknown/evaluateSubscriptionSearchResult; no INT-SYNC for DB-unavailability 503 path (REQ-SYNC-013).

Traceability matrix (lines 152-185) now covers REQ-SYNC-001 through REQ-SYNC-030 with explicit test mappings. INT-SYNC-023 and PROP-SYNC-010 are orphaned (defined but not mapped to any requirement). REQ-SYNC-021 duplication means the traceability anchor is ambiguous. All other requirement-to-test mappings are complete and verifiable.
